text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Kuwait share index falls, volume rises.
- Deputies want military contracts through public tenders.
- U.N. commission in charge of destroying Iraq's mass distruction weapons rejects Baghdad's involvement in inspection of missile parts.
- Indian industrialists team held Kuwait talks to promote products and joint projects.

- Sudanese opposition leader Sadeq al-Mahdi to visit Kuwait soon. Kuwait's ties with Sudan were strained over what the Gulf state saw as Sudanese sympathy with Iraq during its 1990-91 occupation by Iraq.
- Parliament's panel for human rights wants time limits set for detaining people without court orders.
- Kuwait National Petroleum Company sees no expansion soon in the al-Ahmadi refinery.
- Minister of Interior says 90 detainees freed from a deportation centre.
